exact: G1/S host cell cycle checkpoint dysregulation by virus
narrow: perturbation by virus of host G1/S transition checkpoint
related: modulation by virus of host G1/S transition checkpoint

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with the normal execution of the host cell G1/S transition checkpoint. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: G1/S host cell cycle checkpoint dysregulation by virus
